programme.desc: 立勋认定承义之死与景昌有关，派人加强扫荡景昌的地盘，景昌则将被警方盯上的责任归咎于启源。绰姿觉得承义之死，自己有极大责任，拒绝与任何人见面，以铿强迫嘉莉放弃工作，要她留在家中看顾绰姿。刘淼回到故居拜祭，却遇上刘焱，刘淼并没有告知兄长美贞的下落。景昌因刘焱突然回港大为紧张，急忙召见启源问话，但启源亦借此机会与景昌划清界线。嘉莉与以铿的关系日渐疏离，而嘉莉经常借故与启源见面，但启源却与嘉莉保持距离。刘焱终得知美贞与哲行交往的事，潜入了哲行的家，逼刘淼说出美贞及哲行的去向。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #70 粤
programme.desc: 明提出以「与惠佳超市合作」来稳定股价，祥质疑。娜色诱旧情人兼惠佳负责人阿南得悉君企划内容。早已收买了南的上司徐柱岳，岚想出要华假扮君致电给岳，讹称受廉政公署调查，要他公平地对待两家公司。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #71 粤
programme.desc: 祥向娜提出在受勋的记者会上，公开与娜关系，菲表示望能得到祥道歉，祥将家传玉器交给娜。娜因此瞬成为传媒追访的对象，就连明也明言希望娜在认亲后，能成为其媳妇，娜希望菲能与祥和好，戴菲却透露娜并非祥的女儿。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #72 粤
programme.desc: 岚与恒两婆媳又吵了起来，哲成为磨心，依山「妙计」，讹称二人吵架令他无法集中精神，要搬家避开二人，使婆媳二人和好。翌日恒打扫时，发现少了一包燕窝，而刚巧岚偷偷炖燕窝吃，恒怀疑，哲竟想出代岚买回燕窝给恒。

programme.title: 金装四大才子 #43 粤
programme.desc: 守仁欲假造皇上手谕入城救皇上，三子等偷玉石做假玉玺，文宾亦要胁征明雕假玉玺，宁王假传圣旨由自己继位。守仁惶恐之际皇上突然出现。宁王派兵去剿灭败北，于是再派健率大军迎战，子健倒戈，宁王震怒杀劝降大臣。

programme.title: 通天干探 #3 粤
programme.desc: 坤带龙倾生意，龙在饭局中设闭路电视。云对超Sir生前与泰国女子莱过从甚密感伤心。莱主动给钱云，指与超Sir的关系并非如外间想像，云感疑惑。新追查莱时被发现，莱留下信件命新不要随意饮水。如发现三名死者皆家境丰厚，又曾上同一网页浏览，怀疑与快闪党有关。莹随好友参加快闪党，遇上Ray，Ray上门找莹，龙及时扮莹男友，令Ray知难而退。新发现案件与一间教会有关，前往调查，看见教主Rock。龙与坤进行毒品交易，但在当警方准备出动时取消交易，而实则交易并未取消，令邦怀疑龙已经变节。

programme.title: 通天干探 #4 粤
programme.desc: 如派玲与妹混入教会调查Rock，如发现死者尸首内都有某种物质，令寄生虫繁殖迅速，但却不明为何超Sir会牵涉其中。新独自往教会进行调查，却发现莱被囚禁。莱身体满布伤痕，在新追问下，莱终道出自己是Rock女友，指Rock命令她害死超Sir，又指Rock亦是受人所托，莱更说受一名操泰国口音的男子指示。新怀疑是龙，此时新突然被袭。如到教会搜查，并向Rock带回警局查问，却没有所获。新与如到酒吧相聚，Ray趁机将新的水换了，新突然觉得全身发热。

programme.desc: 廉政人员查到承义的户口有一笔不明来历的收入，怀疑承义受贿。美贞担心与哲行同住后会令刘淼感到寂寞，故决定与刘淼一起搬到哲行新居，哲行更希望刘淼能以美贞作为榜样，早日戒除生活陋习。承义一直四处躲藏，立勋找不到他的踪影。绰姿收到了承义的亲笔信，阅毕后因担心承义便偷偷离家与他见面。立勋在两人见面时出现，令承义误以为绰姿出卖自己而逃走，立勋拦截承义后，即要求他鼓起勇气面对自己，但承义仍害怕面对法律制裁而离开。绰姿在街上看见承义从大厦天台跳了下来，绰姿亦因此崩溃痛哭。

programme.title: 金装四大才子 #44 粤
programme.desc: 宁王自刎而死。如花被判流放塞外，子健灌如花饮下堕胎酒。皇上赐婚枝山与石榴，并赠黄金万両作为榴的嫁妆，枝山为了嫁妆欣然接受。石榴发现味觉恢复，华收她为干女儿。子健被封安乐侯，只负责大军衣履鞋袜，众窃笑。

programme.title: 通天干探 #5 粤
programme.desc: 龙的妹凤致电龙，命他记得返家食饭，贺他升职。翌日，龙与旧同学聚会，重遇校花Ada并对Ada动心，刻意制造机会再次聚会。保指龙住在其家期间，弄致四周损坏，要求龙赔钱，龙表示会向上司申请赔偿。新找回当年遭他误杀的青年的母亲，得对方宽恕。龙向保表示要得警方赔偿需等较长时间，于是落手为其住所装修，两人取油漆时遇上顽童，龙教训顽童后竟被村民指他弄伤其子，幸得村长调停。莹渐渐对龙改观，保不停为难龙，莹帮龙说好话。新告知保自己有预知能力，保即命他说出赛马结果，而新突然看到龙将会亲吻莹。

programme.title: 通天干探 #6 粤
programme.desc: 保扮受伤要莹照顾，欲阻止她应征设计工作，遭莹识破。莹与好友虾饺、步姐见工时遇上旧同学Wasabi，Wasabi因美色获聘用。莹与友人到酒吧时再遇Wasabi，龙和Ada亦在此约会。Wasabi对龙倾心，更与莹输赌，若莹能约会龙便给她一万元。莹告知龙，龙即上前邀请她跳舞。离开酒吧时龙见Wasabi一直跟随他和莹，便带莹返家。Ada突然到访，龙要莹躲在露台，令她病倒。龙突然约会莹，当莹以为龙向她示爱之际，Ada突然出现，原来龙想借用莹的专业眼光，为Ada慈善拍卖会的衣服估价。

programme.title: 英雄、刀、少年 #1 粤
programme.desc: 王五自幼丧父，母阮心怡不惜一切送五到武学堂。五遇陈道扬，望扬收为徒。谭嗣同父继洵逼同与李闰成亲，同误闰有吸烟，不屑她。王爷索尔泰为武学堂学政，其女卓兰任性好武。扬得悉五父当年被其兄所杀，决意助五成材。

programme.title: 英雄、刀、少年 #2 粤
programme.desc: 扬答应洵任武学堂教官，并让五考入。旗人多里摩为讨好兰入武学堂。泰看不起扬，任心腹鄂寿明为另一教官。兰倾慕扬。扬虽欣赏明，惜二人立场各异。怡为接近五，到学堂炊事房工作。同渴望入武学堂，洵不允更逼同成亲。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #73 粤
programme.desc: 韦遇上旧女友珊珊，勇将韦电话告之珊，但原来韦曾答应亮不再见珊，勇劝韦应趁亮留学时期，好好地「放一个暑假」。勇发现韦相约珊到别墅，勇联同华及哲到别墅「捉奸」，却不知韦只是在帮珊拍摄咖啡广告而已。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #74 粤
programme.desc: 勇学懂电脑打字，令全公司惊讶。Gary遭网友骗财，勇教训Gary。勇与网友小龙女在视像会议见面，女约勇见面，勇大喜答应，其后女更要到其家中谈天。韦回家发现所有东西被搜刮一空，勇被劫的片段更被放在网上。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #75 粤
programme.desc: 彤瞒著众人接拍「祖与占」广告，负责人大宇哥原来要彤过档，却被娜看到。彤被保安人员逮个正著，岚却在哲的坦白下，明白这全是娜欲立威，岚道出绝对会保护彤，更道出宁愿开罪这名新老板，也不会让无辜的同事含冤！

programme.title: 金装四大才子 #44 粤
programme.desc: 宁王自刎而死。如花被判流放塞外，子健灌如花饮下堕胎酒。皇上赐婚枝山与石榴，并赠黄金万両作为榴的嫁妆，枝山为了嫁妆欣然接受。石榴发现味觉恢复，华收她为干女儿。子健被封安乐侯，只负责大军衣履鞋袜，众窃笑。

programme.title: 通天干探 #5 粤
programme.desc: 龙的妹凤致电龙，命他记得返家食饭，贺他升职。翌日，龙与旧同学聚会，重遇校花Ada并对Ada动心，刻意制造机会再次聚会。保指龙住在其家期间，弄致四周损坏，要求龙赔钱，龙表示会向上司申请赔偿。新找回当年遭他误杀的青年的母亲，得对方宽恕。龙向保表示要得警方赔偿需等较长时间，于是落手为其住所装修，两人取油漆时遇上顽童，龙教训顽童后竟被村民指他弄伤其子，幸得村长调停。莹渐渐对龙改观，保不停为难龙，莹帮龙说好话。新告知保自己有预知能力，保即命他说出赛马结果，而新突然看到龙将会亲吻莹。

programme.title: 通天干探 #6 粤
programme.desc: 保扮受伤要莹照顾，欲阻止她应征设计工作，遭莹识破。莹与好友虾饺、步姐见工时遇上旧同学Wasabi，Wasabi因美色获聘用。莹与友人到酒吧时再遇Wasabi，龙和Ada亦在此约会。Wasabi对龙倾心，更与莹输赌，若莹能约会龙便给她一万元。莹告知龙，龙即上前邀请她跳舞。离开酒吧时龙见Wasabi一直跟随他和莹，便带莹返家。Ada突然到访，龙要莹躲在露台，令她病倒。龙突然约会莹，当莹以为龙向她示爱之际，Ada突然出现，原来龙想借用莹的专业眼光，为Ada慈善拍卖会的衣服估价。

programme.title: 英雄、刀、少年 #1 粤
programme.desc: 王五自幼丧父，母阮心怡不惜一切送五到武学堂。五遇陈道扬，望扬收为徒。谭嗣同父继洵逼同与李闰成亲，同误闰有吸烟，不屑她。王爷索尔泰为武学堂学政，其女卓兰任性好武。扬得悉五父当年被其兄所杀，决意助五成材。

programme.title: 英雄、刀、少年 #2 粤
programme.desc: 扬答应洵任武学堂教官，并让五考入。旗人多里摩为讨好兰入武学堂。泰看不起扬，任心腹鄂寿明为另一教官。兰倾慕扬。扬虽欣赏明，惜二人立场各异。怡为接近五，到学堂炊事房工作。同渴望入武学堂，洵不允更逼同成亲。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #73 粤
programme.desc: 韦遇上旧女友珊珊，勇将韦电话告之珊，但原来韦曾答应亮不再见珊，勇劝韦应趁亮留学时期，好好地「放一个暑假」。勇发现韦相约珊到别墅，勇联同华及哲到别墅「捉奸」，却不知韦只是在帮珊拍摄咖啡广告而已。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #74 粤
programme.desc: 勇学懂电脑打字，令全公司惊讶。Gary遭网友骗财，勇教训Gary。勇与网友小龙女在视像会议见面，女约勇见面，勇大喜答应，其后女更要到其家中谈天。韦回家发现所有东西被搜刮一空，勇被劫的片段更被放在网上。

programme.title: 冲上云霄II #26 粤
programme.desc: 风及芝等为庆祝琛成为Training Captain，特意在家中开派对玩乐，宏带来了已和芝分手的沛。Cadet Program在开始进入模拟飞行训练前，琛却先安排学员以单车模拟飞行及降落，让他们了解困难所在。琛意识到风对晨有爱意后，竟直接向晨提出约会的请求，琛为与晨的约会而制作蛋糕，希见状也要求琛教她，并不断追问是要做给谁人。琛特意带晨和认识怡的同事见面，晨亦请了琛回家倾谈，两人了解加深。希不断试探琛，但琛毫无反应，突然琛在房门外用二胡演奏生日歌，希大感惊喜……

programme.title: 冲上云霄II #27 粤
programme.desc: 骏想邀请麟和娉前往三亚为Skylette的客户拍摄广告，麟找了雄同行，而娉也偕嘉一起出发。芝误会麟向众人透露自己怀孕的秘密，之后芝找麟痛骂。众人在三亚海滩拍摄时，娉一直心不在焉，与骏的对话却是每句都带刺。骏向嘉说出自己曾离婚的往事，回到酒店后竟收到花篮及心意卡，署名竟然是女儿的名字。Cadet Program开始教导模拟飞行，空中服务员训练则开始示范机舱服务程序。麟自知本身英文能力不足，便努力将勤补拙，得到琛的赞赏。芝终发现误会了麟，为了道歉便特意请麟一起吃饭……

programme.title: 冲上云霄II #28 粤
programme.desc: 风收到通知，得悉机长试是由琛负责评核。琛再次约会晨，但却设计特意给风撞破。风得知琛心思后，专诚往停机坪找晨，并将自制的手绳送给晨。风因为机长试而坐立不安，阳发现后约风游车河并开解他。风听从阳的意见不强迫自己温习，但琛觉得弟弟没有危机感。风陪伴芝做产前检查，却因此知道思患上了不治之症。风正式进入最后的驾驶测试，而琛负责从后观察风的飞行。思为了支持风，也特地乘坐风负责的航班，顺道回台湾探亲并见证他完成机长试，但飞行途中思却病发昏迷……

programme.title: 巴不得爸爸 #21 粤
programme.desc: (大结局)慈目睹自己曾经说出不少伤害帆的说话，亦明白帆一直阻止自己和棉见面的原因；帆喜见慈出现在眼前，以为成功阻止他回到过去，慈则解释自己是再次回到2008年，使棉认定自己成为城中富豪乃天命。慈忆起金鱼店那个和芬长得一样的女孩，遂向帆打探她的过去。帆告知自慈突然失踪后，芬亦在风水里消失，众人认定他们私奔。慈问及那女孩的身世，并认出自己的手机时，她却否认自己是芬……慈协助帆收拾泉的遗物时发现一个保险箱，慈忆起泉临终时所说的数字，终解开帆心中的遗憾，慈亦因此得悉自己的身世。

programme.title: 叛逃 #1 粤
programme.desc: 日本恐怖分子佐藤，与东非恐怖分子谈判破裂，被休班警员庄有杰击退。有杰见其兄有打架闹事，原来有正加入黑狗社团当手下，受委托杀佐藤。有杰母唐淑芬见有正欲杀佐藤制止。ATF掌握佐藤地点，派出特种部队拘捕他。

programme.title: 华丽转身 #1 粤
programme.desc: 绰号「罗斌」的影楼老板罗斌汉在机上遇到芳凝，更被她当成疯狂粉丝。台湾富商赖哥顿发现神秘作家「马祖莲娜」竟是桑尚恒，尚恒说服哥顿以自己名义出自传，由他代笔。芳凝向女儿南思坦言答应为哥顿演出全因为南思。

programme.title: 华丽转身 #2 粤
programme.desc: 迪迪带尚恒回酒店房亲热，但她看到芳凝的高跟鞋便清醒过来。芳凝在哥顿授勋庆祝会上献唱，罗斌致电明霞让她欣赏偶像的歌声。芳凝得悉南思将结婚，想从社交网站看女儿的近况。尚恒哄迪迪高声说出对男人的要求……

programme.title: 冲上云霄II #26 粤
programme.desc: 风及芝等为庆祝琛成为Training Captain，特意在家中开派对玩乐，宏带来了已和芝分手的沛。Cadet Program在开始进入模拟飞行训练前，琛却先安排学员以单车模拟飞行及降落，让他们了解困难所在。琛意识到风对晨有爱意后，竟直接向晨提出约会的请求，琛为与晨的约会而制作蛋糕，希见状也要求琛教她，并不断追问是要做给谁人。琛特意带晨和认识怡的同事见面，晨亦请了琛回家倾谈，两人了解加深。希不断试探琛，但琛毫无反应，突然琛在房门外用二胡演奏生日歌，希大感惊喜……

programme.title: 冲上云霄II #27 粤
programme.desc: 骏想邀请麟和娉前往三亚为Skylette的客户拍摄广告，麟找了雄同行，而娉也偕嘉一起出发。芝误会麟向众人透露自己怀孕的秘密，之后芝找麟痛骂。众人在三亚海滩拍摄时，娉一直心不在焉，与骏的对话却是每句都带刺。骏向嘉说出自己曾离婚的往事，回到酒店后竟收到花篮及心意卡，署名竟然是女儿的名字。Cadet Program开始教导模拟飞行，空中服务员训练则开始示范机舱服务程序。麟自知本身英文能力不足，便努力将勤补拙，得到琛的赞赏。芝终发现误会了麟，为了道歉便特意请麟一起吃饭……

programme.title: 冲上云霄II #28 粤
programme.desc: 风收到通知，得悉机长试是由琛负责评核。琛再次约会晨，但却设计特意给风撞破。风得知琛心思后，专诚往停机坪找晨，并将自制的手绳送给晨。风因为机长试而坐立不安，阳发现后约风游车河并开解他。风听从阳的意见不强迫自己温习，但琛觉得弟弟没有危机感。风陪伴芝做产前检查，却因此知道思患上了不治之症。风正式进入最后的驾驶测试，而琛负责从后观察风的飞行。思为了支持风，也特地乘坐风负责的航班，顺道回台湾探亲并见证他完成机长试，但飞行途中思却病发昏迷……

programme.title: 巴不得爸爸 #21 粤
programme.desc: (大结局)慈目睹自己曾经说出不少伤害帆的说话，亦明白帆一直阻止自己和棉见面的原因；帆喜见慈出现在眼前，以为成功阻止他回到过去，慈则解释自己是再次回到2008年，使棉认定自己成为城中富豪乃天命。慈忆起金鱼店那个和芬长得一样的女孩，遂向帆打探她的过去。帆告知自慈突然失踪后，芬亦在风水里消失，众人认定他们私奔。慈问及那女孩的身世，并认出自己的手机时，她却否认自己是芬……慈协助帆收拾泉的遗物时发现一个保险箱，慈忆起泉临终时所说的数字，终解开帆心中的遗憾，慈亦因此得悉自己的身世。

programme.title: 叛逃 #1 粤
programme.desc: 日本恐怖分子佐藤，与东非恐怖分子谈判破裂，被休班警员庄有杰击退。有杰见其兄有打架闹事，原来有正加入黑狗社团当手下，受委托杀佐藤。有杰母唐淑芬见有正欲杀佐藤制止。ATF掌握佐藤地点，派出特种部队拘捕他。

programme.title: 锺馗传说 #12 普
programme.desc: 锺馗是中国民间传说中驱鬼辟邪之神，从古至今，锺馗打鬼捉妖的故事几乎人人熟知，足见锺馗在民间的影响极为深广。据古籍记载，锺馗被唐玄宗敕封为“驱魔大神”，遍行天下“斩妖驱邪”；又被玉皇大帝敕封为专管凡尘

programme.title: 卫子夫 #25 普
programme.desc: 参照《史记》、《汉书》相关记载，讲述汉武帝的第二任妻子卫子夫的人生经历。她出身卑微，入宫后生下长子刘据，成为汉武帝刘彻的第二任皇后。她只是一介平民歌女，没有娇艳媚态，没有显赫家势，但却凭著睿智兰心

programme.desc: 锺馗是中国民间传说中驱鬼辟邪之神，从古至今，锺馗打鬼捉妖的故事几乎人人熟知，足见锺馗在民间的影响极为深广。据古籍记载，锺馗被唐玄宗敕封为“驱魔大神”，遍行天下“斩妖驱邪”；又被玉皇大帝敕封为专管凡尘

programme.title: 卫子夫 #26 普
programme.desc: 参照《史记》、《汉书》相关记载，讲述汉武帝的第二任妻子卫子夫的人生经历。她出身卑微，入宫后生下长子刘据，成为汉武帝刘彻的第二任皇后。她只是一介平民歌女，没有娇艳媚态，没有显赫家势，但却凭著睿智兰心

programme.title: Hands Up #1003 粤
programme.desc: 这集「Kids’ Notes」嘉宾要为大家演奏乐器，但见他双手空空，到底乐器在哪里？原来只要将两只手掌互握起来，就可「成为」一种名为手笛的乐器！手笛「随手可得」，既没有成本与定期维修费用，「带出门」亦无额外负担，背后的发声原理如何？虽然方便携带、随手拥有，手笛却有音域上的限制。小朋友初次接触，不妨先从只有简单几个音调的儿歌开始，慢慢学习。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子 #1356 粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子想吃番薯蛋糕，但妈妈不肯买，她于是想到用举行读书会作借口，让妈妈买蛋糕回来招待朋友。小丸子化身童话故事《不莱梅乐队》的驴子，与花猫、狗和公鸡结伴前往不莱梅温泉乐园组乐队谋生。

programme.desc: Master Joe怀疑超级粉丝Ryan便是Y Pro的真身，为安心起见，他派出AI进行调查，期间，果然有重大发现。此外，AI也会和同学研究溶解作用。在盐、醋、维他命C片、沙、油和淀粉中，哪种材料可溶于水，哪种不可？当中又有何因素影响著材料的溶解度？天文台的工作人员在平常预测和报告天气时，有什么工序？Master Joe带大家参观报道天气的录影室，并讲解天文台人员在报告天气时，幕前和幕后的工作。

programme.title: 可爱巧虎岛 第13季 #31 粤
Hands Up #1004 粤
programme.desc: 廖梓攸穿上优雅的长裙登场，为这次「My Little Show」带来声音清脆的竖琴表演。梓攸分享喜欢以竖琴演奏节奏较明快的古典和现代曲目，还不时会尝试作曲。她经常出埠参加比赛，可会因此感到压力？另外，新一届奥林匹克运动会将于七月在巴黎举行。主持们畅谈各自的心仪观赏运动，并提到本届的冲浪项目，除了有中国运动员参加之外，更有一位年仅十五岁的小女生亦取得出赛资格，令人期待。

programme.title: DaDa DeDe 精灵乐园 #5 粤
programme.desc: 上集嘉宾盖世宝宣布加入《DaDaDeDe精灵乐园》，联同王祖蓝及戚黛黛一同担任主持。特别嘉宾邓健泓献唱其童年时的儿歌<共享阳光，又与主持合唱家传户晓的<世界界真细小。左右难分是部份小朋友的通病，王祖蓝、盖世宝及邓健泓在戚黛黛的结他伴奏下，合唱儿歌<The Hokey Pokey，教小朋友唱歌学分左右手。还有游戏「动作马拉松」、「动手动脚动脑筋」和IQ题问答继续放送，小朋友玩得不亦乐乎。

programme.title: 爱犬讯号 #10 粤日
programme.desc: 这天，浅沼太太带著约瑟爹利小花，向丹羽与未祐求助。小花有著吃饭时将食物藏起来的坏习惯，丹羽推测这种行为，可能是出于小花不想给家中小孩夺走食物，于是建议增加用餐次数，并与小孩分房进食，然而……

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主 #9 粤日
programme.desc: 偶像公主空间最近有传闹鬼，千依也在直播中追查，令怕鬼的美月看得当场昏倒。为了抓住幽灵，阳葵决定前往偶像公主空间，还找上同场的千依组成侦探团，一起调查闹鬼的真相。到底幽灵的真正身分是谁？

programme.title: 72行小人类 #3 粤
programme.desc: 今集共有两位小朋友进行行业试做，第一位胜见苑和试做唱片骑师，她表现淡定，更有机会跟资深DJ梁奕伦及梁继璋学做DJ，主持一集节目。另一位罗筠麒想做宠物美容师，由宠物美容师余淑贞教导下学习成为宠物美容师，更替小狗设计新造型。此外，节目亦介绍了当当糖老师傅曾伯，曾伯做当当糖四十多年仍乐于坚持，更教观众做当当糖的窍门，节目更送了一个新镬铲给他。「物尽奇用」则请来众艺员猜猜一件类似灯罩的塑胶物件究竟是何物。

programme.title: 72行小人类 #4 粤
programme.desc: 今集共有三位小朋友进行行业试做，第一组小朋友分别是区朗莹及陈映彤试做点心师傅，她们表现专心，更以比赛形式测试学做点心的成绩。另一位小人类林毅想做农夫，由农场负责人叶子盛教导下学习成为农夫，以及他试做一天农夫的感觉。此外，节目亦介绍了打面老师傅谭双良，谭双良做面五十多年打出名堂，更教观众做面的窍门，他单手便能摸出面粉的种类。而「物尽奇用」则请来众艺员猜猜究竟是何物。

programme.desc: 今集共有三位小朋友进行行业试做，第一组小朋友分别是区朗莹及陈映彤试做点心师傅，她们表现专心，更以比赛形式测试学做点心的成绩。另一位小人类林毅想做农夫，由农场负责人叶子盛教导下学习成为农夫，以及他试做一天农夫的感觉。此外，节目亦介绍了打面老师傅谭双良，谭双良做面五十多年打出名堂，更教观众做面的窍门，他单手便能摸出面粉的种类。而「物尽奇用」则请来众艺员猜猜究竟是何物。

programme.title: DaDa DeDe 精灵乐园 #5 粤
programme.desc: 上集嘉宾盖世宝宣布加入《DaDaDeDe精灵乐园》，联同王祖蓝及戚黛黛一同担任主持。特别嘉宾邓健泓献唱其童年时的儿歌<共享阳光，又与主持合唱家传户晓的<世界界真细小。左右难分是部份小朋友的通病，王祖蓝、盖世宝及邓健泓在戚黛黛的结他伴奏下，合唱儿歌<The Hokey Pokey，教小朋友唱歌学分左右手。还有游戏「动作马拉松」、「动手动脚动脑筋」和IQ题问答继续放送，小朋友玩得不亦乐乎。

programme.title: 爱犬讯号 #10 粤日
programme.desc: 这天，浅沼太太带著约瑟爹利小花，向丹羽与未祐求助。小花有著吃饭时将食物藏起来的坏习惯，丹羽推测这种行为，可能是出于小花不想给家中小孩夺走食物，于是建议增加用餐次数，并与小孩分房进食，然而……

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #27
programme.desc: 国王不想与人分享他的新火箭驱动滑板,所以把它藏在一个魔法盒子里。姑毛和比路决定取得它,挑战国王的意愿,最终进入一个更大的新世界。一个充满乐趣和……危险的世界。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #28
programme.desc: 皇后心情不好。国王和孩子们同意举办有史以来最好的生日派对。不幸的是,每个参与者对于如何组织女王的惊喜派对都有个别非常特别的想法。它的成功将取决于他们「易地而处」的能力。尤其是女王。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #29
programme.desc: 比路厌倦了女王,他认为女王试图毁掉他所有的冒险和游戏。在满天流星的星夜,比路许下一个愿望:愿女王变回少女,让他为所欲为。当比路的愿望成真,他将必须当个疯狂的小女王哥哥,并意识到这可能是很艰巨的任务,有时甚至很危险。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #30
programme.desc: 今天是姑毛的生日,他有很高期望。不幸的是,他醒来发现珍爱的头盔不见了!最重要的是,他的朋友们表现得很奇怪,他们似乎都忘记了他的生日。姑毛很乐意让一切恢复正常。幸运的是,他收到一个惊喜,可以让这天成为一个非常特别的日子。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #31
programme.desc: 安高在与比路和姑毛玩耍时弄伤了自己,因此必须在家休息几天。比路感到内疚,决定搬进安高的房子,直到他的朋友好转为止。他们对生活的不同看法相交,然后一起发现如果睁大眼睛看一切,即使是最小的细节,也可以很享受。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #32
programme.desc: 莉塔在米娜的实验室试做自己的实验。她很快就发现首先需要学习一些基础知识来避免灾难发生。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #33
programme.desc: 比路发现他最好的朋友有音乐天赋。从那一刻起,他将尝试与其他朋友分享发现。尽管姑毛很害羞,比路还是会尝试揭露和分享这个秘密。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #34
programme.desc: 姑毛弄丢了他用来和比路玩啫堡侠和头盔仔的眼镜。他们都发现一只戴著姑毛眼镜的瞎子渡渡鸟。戴上它后,渡渡鸟可以重见光明,并与其他渡渡鸟玩耍。姑毛会放弃他的眼镜,还是取回它去当超级英雄?

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #35
programme.desc: 莉塔和公主正在举行一场可爱的粉红色野餐:粉红色的菜肴、粉红色的食物、粉红色的一切!莉塔向公主倾诉她希望啫堡上的所有东西都是她最喜欢的颜色。她冲到音乐工厂,将五颜六色的音乐泡泡变成粉红色,这可能会让一切变得一样!当其他孩子意识到莉塔的行动时,他们必须在啫堡变成一片大而无聊、贫瘠的粉红色荒地前,努力恢复

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #36
programme.desc: 姑毛和莉塔正在户外度过愉快的一天,突然发现一颗渡渡鸟蛋。孩子们和小鸡蛋将进行动作连场的冒险。经过这么多的喧嚣,鸟蛋能存活下来吗?

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #37
programme.desc: 音盘已经疯了,啫堡中的所有声音都被改变,造成了巨大的混乱。比路和莉塔将负责将每一个声音归还到它所属的地方。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #38
programme.desc: 比路必须戴眼罩。他因外表而感到不舒服和沮丧。幸运的是,他的朋友们用一首歌的智慧提醒他,任何问题都可以变成有趣的事情。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #27
programme.desc: 国王不想与人分享他的新火箭驱动滑板,所以把它藏在一个魔法盒子里。姑毛和比路决定取得它,挑战国王的意愿,最终进入一个更大的新世界。一个充满乐趣和……危险的世界。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #28
programme.desc: 皇后心情不好。国王和孩子们同意举办有史以来最好的生日派对。不幸的是,每个参与者对于如何组织女王的惊喜派对都有个别非常特别的想法。它的成功将取决于他们「易地而处」的能力。尤其是女王。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #29
programme.desc: 比路厌倦了女王,他认为女王试图毁掉他所有的冒险和游戏。在满天流星的星夜,比路许下一个愿望:愿女王变回少女,让他为所欲为。当比路的愿望成真,他将必须当个疯狂的小女王哥哥,并意识到这可能是很艰巨的任务,有时甚至很危险。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #30
programme.desc: 今天是姑毛的生日,他有很高期望。不幸的是,他醒来发现珍爱的头盔不见了!最重要的是,他的朋友们表现得很奇怪,他们似乎都忘记了他的生日。姑毛很乐意让一切恢复正常。幸运的是,他收到一个惊喜,可以让这天成为一个非常特别的日子。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #31
programme.desc: 安高在与比路和姑毛玩耍时弄伤了自己,因此必须在家休息几天。比路感到内疚,决定搬进安高的房子,直到他的朋友好转为止。他们对生活的不同看法相交,然后一起发现如果睁大眼睛看一切,即使是最小的细节,也可以很享受。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #32
programme.desc: 莉塔在米娜的实验室试做自己的实验。她很快就发现首先需要学习一些基础知识来避免灾难发生。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #33

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #34

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #35
programme.desc: 莉塔和公主正在举行一场可爱的粉红色野餐:粉红色的菜肴、粉红色的食物、粉红色的一切!莉塔向公主倾诉她希望啫堡上的所有东西都是她最喜欢的颜色。她冲到音乐工厂,将五颜六色的音乐泡泡变成粉红色,这可能会让一切变得一样!当其他孩子意识到莉塔的行动时,他们必须在啫堡变成一片大而无聊、贫瘠的粉红色荒地前,努力恢复

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #36

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #37

programme.title: 江湖三女侠(上)
programme.desc: 独臂神尼临终前嘱咐弟子吕四娘完成其遗志。反清首领沈在宽被了恩囚于天牢，四娘与天山弟子唐晓澜及冯瑛赶往相救。他们于宫中遇到琳贵人，原来她是瑛自小失散的妹，在琳的帮忙下救出宽，并手刃了恩，完成神尼的遗愿。

programme.title: 面子问题
programme.desc: 贾天雄的纺织厂周转不灵，却因面子而拒绝将之卖掉。雄见马永年酷似南洋富商冯定德，要年假扮德，以骗好友及钱太母女入股。谁料钱也是表面风光，更要女儿绮萍亲近年；年与萍互生情愫，后雄的骗局被揭，幸年获萍原谅。

programme.title: 万里寻亲记
programme.desc: 孤女小萍被养父卖给卖艺老人为徒，惜师父被恶霸殴伤致死，萍唯有卖唱维生，歌声感动了金太并获她收留。萍回乡探望养母，时金发现萍是其失踪之女，派人接她回家；金二叔为谋家产，施计谋害萍，幸萍逃脱并与生母相认。

programme.title: 天河配
programme.desc: 牛郎与织女相恋，王母大怒贬牛郎为凡人，织女则留守天宫，天人永隔。牛郎重遇偷下凡间的织女，二人续缘。王母得悉后以天河隔绝二人，喜鹊却架起鹊桥助二人相聚。王母欲毁桥，幸得南极仙翁求情，两人得以在七夕相会。

programme.title: 通缉令
programme.desc: 特派专员倪义离奇死亡，手中更紧握著一张通缉令。义的女儿美萍从日本赶回来，多番遭遇刺杀，幸有惊无险。义的秘书李君雄与探长引出凶徒，令他们相继落网。雄与萍日久生情，然而探长怀疑雄对案情有隐瞒，加上其后探长与萍发现雄与通缉犯李公侠相识，更惹两人疑惑。萍再度遇袭，侠等人终被捕，并供出他与义的恩怨，以及受萍的姨母唆使而杀害萍，雄亦道出义因得悉自己罹患绝症而自杀的真相。此时萍惊悉义非其生父，并与亲生父母相认。

programme.title: 贫贱夫妻百事哀
programme.desc: 大只广失业后沉迷赌博，令妻女生活贫苦。广弟妻雪莉与刘望的奸情被广妻撞破，故莉诬蔑广妻与何守安有染，广把妻子赶走。广到麻雀馆当杂工，看见莉因欠债而被望虐打，广终觉悟，向妻子认错求原谅，并与家人过新生活。

programme.title: 七喜临门
programme.desc: 王文正被外貌与自己相像的周新沃窃财，警探袁振刚误会正是犯人，将其拘捕，后方知弄错。刚遇上沃，误会他是正，求他答应自己与其女妙娴的婚事，沃随口应允。正、沃碰头，众人恍然大悟，更发现刚是正失散多年的儿子。

programme.title: 江湖三女侠(下)

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队:死亡追捕 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​穿梭于昆士兰沿海的混乱景象与喧嚣之中,杰丝勇敢面对她内心的恐惧,追逐一只攀爬至树上的蕾丝蜥蜴,而那棵树上还栖息著活跃繁忙的蜂巢观看斯图小心翼翼地将一条被困在篱笆之间的东方褐蛇救出,并观察米克为惊慌不安的屋主捕捉那条滑溜难抓,灵活的巨蟒

programme.title: 奇异地球 #1 英普
programme.desc: 看看一些动物如何从出生就被注入「怪异」基因,并观赏园丁鸟为吸引配偶而呈献的奇特舞蹈动作到圣诞岛见证螃蟹使出躲避交通的当家本领,以及红鲑惊人的逆流游泳技能

programme.title: 奇异地球 #2 英普
programme.desc: 本集带观众暸解一些赋予动物生存优势的超强能力目睹萤火虫迷人的闪光,眼镜猴惊人的夜视能力;见证螳螂虾的致命一击,以及了解帮助咸水鳄检测猎物的压力感应器

programme.title: 狮群的法则 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙热高温,当狮群努力狩猎足够食物,干旱条件逼迫他们与猎物一同陷入接近死亡的险境,生命几乎被推向边缘观看爱因斯坦适应孤独生活,然后评估战场残局,在新手母亲卡尔维兹为幼崽性命而奋战之后

programme.title: 动物知心友 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和狮子西尔加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人类好友瓦尔自她还是失去父母的幼崽时就一直在她身边看乌鸦洛基逗乐他的挚友艾略特,与𫚉鱼哈格尔依偎拥抱,并了解为什么无尾熊崔许与盖瑞就像一家人

programme.title: 动物知心友 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由骆驼艾伯特与他的人类朋友亚历克斯共同打理的牧场巡视,接著探访小袋鼠贺比,他正被好友弗勒细心照顾与袋鼬昆西一起制造一点混乱,并和冲浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起挂在浪上

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #1
programme.desc: 哥伦比亚海岸附近,新生的座头鲸吸了牠的第一口气牠身长16呎,是一个巨人,但未来的挑战跟牠一样巨大在进行地球上最长的迁徙之一前,牠必须快点长大

programme.title: 「礁」来船祸 #3
programme.desc: 巴哈马被称为水底电影世界的首都荷里活已经到访这里几十年了,在水晶般清澈的水底制作史诗式的电影和电视戏剧节目,其中的大热景点包括许多电影般的沉船

programme.title: 壮丽的「堡」贝 #1
programme.desc: 探索美丽的海德堡城堡,它的废墟屹立在德国西部的内卡河旁这座城堡位于受保护的自然保育区中,是猛禽的家园,亦是附近两栖类的产卵场

programme.title: 壮丽的「堡」贝 #2
programme.desc: 前往拥有数百年历史的法国堡垒,它是史上一些最伟大帝国的家园卡尔卡松曾是财富和文化的中心,如今已成为野生动物的避难所鸟类,野猪和昆虫大军在其丰裕的环境中生存

programme.title: 壮丽的「堡」贝 #3
programme.desc: 发掘刻在洞穴里世上最大的城堡斯洛文尼亚的洞窟城堡不仅为中世纪的人类居民提供了保护,而且还为该区的鸟类,野猪和野山羊提供了避难所

programme.title: 壮丽的「堡」贝 #4
programme.desc: 游览西班牙格林纳达地区一生必到的非凡堡垒- 阿尔罕布拉宫这个世界文化遗产现在成了该地区野生动植物的庇护所它拥有众多溪流和喷泉,可供应两栖类,鱼类和鸟类

programme.title: 壮丽的「堡」贝 #5
programme.desc: 了解世上最壮观的建筑之一 - 新天鹅堡及其周边的森林如何成为许多生物的家园从阿尔卑斯羱羊到雄伟的天鹅,这座城堡于数世纪以来成了天然避难所

programme.title: 美国野生边界:北部揭秘 英普
programme.desc: 沿著美加之间最长的边境,野生动物犹如同时活在两个世界动物在障碍和矛盾的规则间如履薄冰,一念天堂一念地狱

programme.title: 鲨鱼星球 #1
programme.desc: 与鲨鱼一起在海中潜行,看他们使用高度敏锐的感官和杀手的本能进行捕猎观看白顶礁鲨利用其电子传感器探测心跳来寻找猎物,以及浅海长尾鲨用其鞭状的尾巴来击晕猎物

programme.title: 鲨鱼星球 #2
programme.desc: 与那些在蓝色的虚空中繁衍生息的流浪鲨鱼一起领略海洋的广阔,深邃与黑暗见识穿越大西洋风暴的海域的孤独蓝鲨,以及返回太平洋岛屿繁殖地的数百条双髻鲨

programme.title: 鲨鱼星球 #3
programme.desc: 跟随一群具有非凡能力的鲨鱼,牠们可以在全球最恶劣的环境中繁衍生息观察在冰冷的北极水域生活,但几乎失明的格林兰鲨,以及另外一种能在陆地行走的物种

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #1
programme.desc: 哥伦比亚海岸附近,新生的座头鲸吸了牠的第一口气牠身长16呎,是一个巨人,但未来的挑战跟牠一样巨大在进行地球上最长的迁徙之一前,牠必须快点长大

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #2
programme.desc: 随著松鼠猴的繁殖季节临近,女强人艾巴必须带领牠的团伙寻找食物,但男领袖撒母耳能夺得芳心吗?年轻的沙奇拿迷了路,而敌人逐渐紧逼,局势开始紧张

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #1 英普
programme.desc: 前往桑布鲁,看看在当地的一条河流干涸后,女族长阿纳斯塔西亚如何领著牠的象群向北方前进然后来到纳波西奥,看看猎豹母亲库莱塔如何躲避狡猾的猎狗群最后,在莱基皮亚,看看野狗菲尼克斯和牠的新窝

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #2 英普
programme.desc: 探索大象挖井的巧妙方式,看到突然间使河水满溢的倾盆大雨带来的欢喜在狮子杀死猎豹的一只幼崽后,为库莱塔的丧子之痛而哀悼并在野狗菲尼克斯与凶狠的猎狗对峙时观看实时战况

programme.title: 大猫九命 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描绘狮子生命的九个阶段,从无助的小狮子到自信的成年狮,再到年老的流亡者看看竞争,饥饿和骄傲的动态如何塑造它在塞伦盖提的生活,并见证使这种社交猫独特的忠诚和合作精神

programme.title: 大猫九命 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​与一只小小的幼狮一起在森林中穿行,观看年轻的成年狮如何宣示自己的领土,并见证年老猎人的不可避免的流亡发现本能和潜行如何帮助老虎在它孤独的世界中生存,在这里每一个决定都充满风险

programme.title: 深入印度 #5 英普
programme.desc: 地球上最具代表性的动物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的丛林中徘徊在一天的过程中,我们追随一位母亲和三只幼崽 她必须为家人提供足够的食物来维持生计

programme.title: 大猫小世界 #1 英普
programme.desc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的来临,豹妈妈费芙和狮妈妈莎芭正在教导她们的幼宝宝如何在危机四伏的野外求存,并让他们远离成年雄性的威胁看看狮王莫雷洛如何战斗,猎豹森娜蒂亚则试图在战场上证明自己的地位

programme.title: 大猫小世界 #2 英普
programme.desc: 紧贴莫雷洛狮群的行踪;当冬季洪水到来时,他们因照顾幼狮而精疲力尽见证猎豹幼宝宝如何作出艰难的决定,并目击豹妈妈塞菲丽在经历一场可怕的遭遇后,如何在自己家族与幼宝宝之间作出抉择

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队:死亡追捕 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​穿梭于昆士兰沿海的混乱景象与喧嚣之中,杰丝勇敢面对她内心的恐惧,追逐一只攀爬至树上的蕾丝蜥蜴,而那棵树上还栖息著活跃繁忙的蜂巢观看斯图小心翼翼地将一条被困在篱笆之间的东方褐蛇救出,并观察米克为惊慌不安的屋主捕捉那条滑溜难抓,灵活的巨蟒

programme.title: 奇异地球 #1 英普
programme.desc: 看看一些动物如何从出生就被注入「怪异」基因,并观赏园丁鸟为吸引配偶而呈献的奇特舞蹈动作到圣诞岛见证螃蟹使出躲避交通的当家本领,以及红鲑惊人的逆流游泳技能

programme.title: 奇异地球 #2 英普
programme.desc: 本集带观众暸解一些赋予动物生存优势的超强能力目睹萤火虫迷人的闪光,眼镜猴惊人的夜视能力;见证螳螂虾的致命一击,以及了解帮助咸水鳄检测猎物的压力感应器

programme.title: 狮群的法则 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙热高温,当狮群努力狩猎足够食物,干旱条件逼迫他们与猎物一同陷入接近死亡的险境,生命几乎被推向边缘观看爱因斯坦适应孤独生活,然后评估战场残局,在新手母亲卡尔维兹为幼崽性命而奋战之后

programme.title: 动物知心友 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和狮子西尔加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人类好友瓦尔自她还是失去父母的幼崽时就一直在她身边看乌鸦洛基逗乐他的挚友艾略特,与𫚉鱼哈格尔依偎拥抱,并了解为什么无尾熊崔许与盖瑞就像一家人

programme.title: 动物知心友 #1

programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​冲进崭新的郊区社区,驯蛇专家努力阻止致命毒蛇滑入普通家庭住宅观看斯图与莉芙将一条东方褐蛇从工地移出,杰丝与丹将巨蟒从仓库中驱逐出去,而米克与阿黛尔则将红腹蛇赶出卧室,确保屋主生活区域的安全

programme.title: 生命之旅 #2 英普
programme.desc: 赞比亚的幼崽由成长至生育,皆面临著巨大挑战,每个教训都意味著生死一线牠们成年的过程需要技巧,力量,勇气和大量的运气

programme.title: 壮丽的「堡」贝 #1
programme.desc: 探索美丽的海德堡城堡,它的废墟屹立在德国西部的内卡河旁这座城堡位于受保护的自然保育区中,是猛禽的家园,亦是附近两栖类的产卵场

programme.title: 壮丽的「堡」贝 #2
programme.desc: 前往拥有数百年历史的法国堡垒,它是史上一些最伟大帝国的家园卡尔卡松曾是财富和文化的中心,如今已成为野生动物的避难所鸟类,野猪和昆虫大军在其丰裕的环境中生存

programme.title: 壮丽的「堡」贝 #3
programme.desc: 发掘刻在洞穴里世上最大的城堡斯洛文尼亚的洞窟城堡不仅为中世纪的人类居民提供了保护,而且还为该区的鸟类,野猪和野山羊提供了避难所

programme.title: 壮丽的「堡」贝 #4
programme.desc: 游览西班牙格林纳达地区一生必到的非凡堡垒- 阿尔罕布拉宫这个世界文化遗产现在成了该地区野生动植物的庇护所它拥有众多溪流和喷泉,可供应两栖类,鱼类和鸟类

programme.title: 壮丽的「堡」贝 #5
programme.desc: 了解世上最壮观的建筑之一 - 新天鹅堡及其周边的森林如何成为许多生物的家园从阿尔卑斯羱羊到雄伟的天鹅,这座城堡于数世纪以来成了天然避难所

programme.title: 美国野生边界:北部揭秘 英普
programme.desc: 沿著美加之间最长的边境,野生动物犹如同时活在两个世界动物在障碍和矛盾的规则间如履薄冰,一念天堂一念地狱

programme.title: 鲨鱼星球 #1
programme.desc: 与鲨鱼一起在海中潜行,看他们使用高度敏锐的感官和杀手的本能进行捕猎观看白顶礁鲨利用其电子传感器探测心跳来寻找猎物,以及浅海长尾鲨用其鞭状的尾巴来击晕猎物

programme.title: 鲨鱼星球 #2
programme.desc: 与那些在蓝色的虚空中繁衍生息的流浪鲨鱼一起领略海洋的广阔,深邃与黑暗见识穿越大西洋风暴的海域的孤独蓝鲨,以及返回太平洋岛屿繁殖地的数百条双髻鲨

programme.title: 鲨鱼星球 #3
programme.desc: 跟随一群具有非凡能力的鲨鱼,牠们可以在全球最恶劣的环境中繁衍生息观察在冰冷的北极水域生活,但几乎失明的格林兰鲨,以及另外一种能在陆地行走的物种

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #1
programme.desc: 哥伦比亚海岸附近,新生的座头鲸吸了牠的第一口气牠身长16呎,是一个巨人,但未来的挑战跟牠一样巨大在进行地球上最长的迁徙之一前,牠必须快点长大

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #2

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #1 英普
programme.desc: 前往桑布鲁,看看在当地的一条河流干涸后,女族长阿纳斯塔西亚如何领著牠的象群向北方前进然后来到纳波西奥,看看猎豹母亲库莱塔如何躲避狡猾的猎狗群最后,在莱基皮亚,看看野狗菲尼克斯和牠的新窝

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #2 英普
programme.desc: 探索大象挖井的巧妙方式,看到突然间使河水满溢的倾盆大雨带来的欢喜在狮子杀死猎豹的一只幼崽后,为库莱塔的丧子之痛而哀悼并在野狗菲尼克斯与凶狠的猎狗对峙时观看实时战况

programme.title: 大猫九命 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描绘狮子生命的九个阶段,从无助的小狮子到自信的成年狮,再到年老的流亡者看看竞争,饥饿和骄傲的动态如何塑造它在塞伦盖提的生活,并见证使这种社交猫独特的忠诚和合作精神

programme.title: 大猫九命 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​与一只小小的幼狮一起在森林中穿行,观看年轻的成年狮如何宣示自己的领土,并见证年老猎人的不可避免的流亡发现本能和潜行如何帮助老虎在它孤独的世界中生存,在这里每一个决定都充满风险

programme.title: 深入印度 #5 英普
programme.desc: 地球上最具代表性的动物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的丛林中徘徊在一天的过程中,我们追随一位母亲和三只幼崽 她必须为家人提供足够的食物来维持生计

programme.title: 大猫小世界 #1 英普
programme.desc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的来临,豹妈妈费芙和狮妈妈莎芭正在教导她们的幼宝宝如何在危机四伏的野外求存,并让他们远离成年雄性的威胁看看狮王莫雷洛如何战斗,猎豹森娜蒂亚则试图在战场上证明自己的地位

programme.title: 大猫小世界 #2 英普
programme.desc: 紧贴莫雷洛狮群的行踪;当冬季洪水到来时,他们因照顾幼狮而精疲力尽见证猎豹幼宝宝如何作出艰难的决定,并目击豹妈妈塞菲丽在经历一场可怕的遭遇后,如何在自己家族与幼宝宝之间作出抉择

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 2 #8

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners Their large size is one of their features Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets

programme.title: Kabul, Just Before Darkness

programme.title: The Huddle
programme.desc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish

高朋满座#225粤
programme.desc: 庆发起在社区中心千叟宴，惜因食物供应商被查封，不能提供食物，庆将事情揹于身上，高家会总动员帮忙。可是庆回到家中，欲提出此事时，众人却因要准备过年物件，根本没有人理会庆。结果，只有丽及亨答应帮忙。

programme.title: 玉楼春#39粤普
programme.desc: 孙金阁捣腾一些玩意竟发生爆炸，玉楼和哥哥详谈之下发现金阁是有远大抱负的人；少春趁机把金阁推荐给皇上；孙逊发现少春怀有东鲛珠，一问之下才知是柳三绝给她的，勾起了孙逊的一段青春回忆。

programme.title: 方德证券独家呈现:交易现场粤 及 潮流生活志之时尚头条粤
阿妈教落食平D粤
programme.desc: 对肥妈而言，十人大餐零难度，先煮其中四道菜及一个汤。加入红菜头烹煮的罗宋汤，有甚么特别益处？肥妈示范用椰菜花剁碎，务求做出西瓜pizza以外的另一经典！六号请缨用手拍青瓜，配合简易的汁料，演绎制作「手拍黄瓜」的容易度。肥妈动手把花龙虾开边，让牠变身为美味的「芝士香草龙虾」宴客菜。一块优质安格斯肉眼扒，为何肥妈不涂橄榄油而用芥花籽油？煎扒时与观众温故知新，重提冷藏牛扒处理重点。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 胸腺属于免疫系统器官，主要功能是协助抵抗感染、疾病。胸腺一旦出现肿瘤，有机会影响呼吸，甚至诱发重症肌无力，留意心胸肺外科医生带来诊治资讯。沈宗贤、阮慧珊带同新合唱歌<伽利略的星星作客节目，畅谈这首浪漫情歌的创作故事。阮阮笑言因彼此太熟，初时难以投入演绎恋人氛围。谈到录音趣事，阮阮「控诉」频频被拍档宗贤纠正普通话发音，二人还会即席献唱新歌。「睇𩠌食饭」环节，傅季馨示范香浓美食「咖喱牛肉手抓馅饼」。

programme.title: LAW霸女神粤
programme.desc: 打工仔关心劳工法律问题，笑称是「无良雇主」的林盛斌也来一解疑惑。亲戚来港旅游却在家人的餐厅义务工作，老板可有犯法？至于雇员在家工作时被烫伤，Bob直言雇主不用负法律责任，韵芝以澳洲个案反驳其观点。老板向迟到员工扣薪，拨入「下午茶福利」，认为合法的Bob再次未获女神们支持，结果如何？若介绍客户到夜总会进行性交易但没收取报酬，可属违法？祖仪笑言「金牌媒人」Bob的撮合行为与个案性质相近，惹众人爆笑！

programme.title: 大帅哥#1粤PG

programme.title: 兄弟姊妹去旅行粤

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤

programme.title: 警声百二秒 IV粤

programme.title: 世界养生组织粤

programme.title: Gi味俱全粤

programme.title: 地球大神秘粤PG

programme.title: 星光魔法粤日

programme.title: Hands Up粤

programme.desc: 森林里神秘怪事频生。巨大陷阱出现，栗子消失，昆虫失踪，橡实从天而降！要交由大侦探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly组成的查查林部队调查。牠们未必是最能干的侦探队，但往往能够迎刃而解，揭开大自然奥秘。

programme.title: 2026年王者荣耀KPL年度总决赛·决赛直播粤普
programme.desc: 「王者荣耀」KPL十周年，两支北京电竞队在年度总决赛狭路相逢，争逐荣耀加冕！北京JDG战队一路由胜者组强势推进，明星选手无畏、清融是致胜关键。北京WB战队从败者组逆袭而归，打野暖阳、射手昭珏都是阵中核心。此外，表演嘉宾周深会以歌声加持「荣耀」殿堂。TVB翡翠台、明珠台接力播映这场BO7大战，主持张与辰、彭家贤、施焯日、嘉宾罗泳娴、小编黄滢仴，联同两位电竞评述员老星、伍嘉豪，跟观众迎接「王者」驾临！

programme.title: 潮流生活志之时尚头条粤
programme.desc: 香港，一个中西荟萃、新旧共融的国际都市，不论吃喝、玩乐、购物都多姿多采。节目中主持人会介绍最新的潮流资讯和生活热话，为你发掘香港更精彩的一面，讲究生活和追求时尚的你绝对不能错过。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
新闻透视粤
programme.desc: 香港连续16年成为楼价最难负担城巿，为了让买家更易「上车」，10多年前本港出现面积细、总价低的纳米楼，最细实用面积只有128呎。但近年陆续有纳米楼蚀让，部分跌价超过五成，自住业主「先上车、后换楼」的计划暂时未能实现，他们长年蜗居的生活是怎样？政府五年规划提出逐步增加室内楼面面积，让巿民住大点。在解决迫切房屋需求的同时，政府如何在增加居住空间上作出平衡？楼面面积增加，港人买楼难的「老问题」又可否解决呢？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 渣打优先理财呈献：Grand住去首尔粤
programme.desc: 参观百年历史韩屋，海宁细味传统韩茶文化，寻回久违的自在慢活。随后，她会跟韩国小鲜肉甜蜜约会学制陶瓷花樽，更齐齐登船夜游睇靓景兼谈天。嘉洛与朱仔相约大吃烤鳗鱼补身，体验韩国男人的进补之道。二人接着兵分两路，嘉洛造访顶流韩星御用美容院大改造，变身韩系型男走在街头，成功吸引「韩国妹猪」集邮；朱仔则换上量身订制西装，静心品尝美酒独享优雅时刻。压轴三人会合享用新派韩国料理，前菜的滋味已令大家失去言语能力！

programme.title: 香港旅游发展局呈献：香港连场好戏粤PG
programme.desc: 从剧情片中的逆境奋斗故事，领会香港精神！现已拆卸的九龙城寨，曾有「三不管」的传奇色彩，两主持约同演员伍允龙走进电影展览馆，穿梭光影场景与旧日时空交织的「围城」。砵甸乍街、中环街市等历史角落，散发着独特的电影韵味；深入石澳，也可细味《喜剧之王》的追梦与爱情故事。《逆流大叔》于城门河奋力划桨，电影导演陈咏燊诉说创作灵感。《毒舌大状》为讨公义，在前粉岭裁判法院唇枪舌剑，演员谢君豪忆述实景拍摄法庭戏感受。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
香港赛马会特约：J Sport粤 及 潮流生活志之时尚头条粤
programme.desc: 香港车手方俊宇将伙拍德国名将晏高，征战澳门大赛车GT世界杯，俊宇从拍档身上学到甚么？西班牙球星大卫施华首战港超联，助至尊沙田以1比1赛和标准流浪，他还会畅谈来港踢波感受。黎志豪当选新一任榄总主席，他提到希望将本港榄球推动到社区，及发展至大湾区。五位健美港将会出战亚锦赛，备战情况如何？香港马术盛典将于1月举行，法国骑手率先来港交流。另搜罗三铁世界杯战报，以及壁球公开赛、粤港澳大湾区匹克球赛记招花絮。

programme.title: 飞虎3壮志英雄#21粤PG
programme.desc: Mike涉嫌一宗谋杀案而被通缉，Mike向Don坚称被陷害；博文问敏莉有否见过Mike，她称没有；素筠向敏莉表示自己患有渐冻症，希望她不要告诉博文；嘉轩和家宝调查许森的背景，发现收养他的济群会有问题，于是再深入调查。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粤PG
programme.desc: 全新一辑《地球大神秘》，以探秘的角度及专业的手法，深入拆解世上各种不解谜团［Secret X］。［Secret X］代表未知、极致、禁忌，以及一切等待被发现真相的代号。透过揭开隐藏于挪亚方舟的终极奥秘，得以更了解贯穿世界一切事物的「神秘的祢」，从而在陷入乱局的这一刻，找到如何活得平安及丰盛，以及寻找到永恒不灭的主宰。

programme.title: 如果这样生活粤
programme.desc: 在云南大理，黎诺懿继续协助法籍私房菜大厨预备招待各国来的朋友，终教他明白法国菜要吃多个小时的理由！诺懿煲出水鸭汤让大家品评，结论竟是各人演技太好？诺懿乘船登上大理唯一有人居住的小岛，到一间由曾是互联网公司强人营办的民宿，帮忙招待客人，客人却嫌弃他太吵！工作步伐不需急促，反而令诺懿感到纳闷，幸好老板带他到市集闲逛，诺懿竟找到适合杨明食用的手信？试过了归隐田园，诺懿还坚持向往田园生活吗？

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 粤语「㜺鬼」传神，博大精深，香港不少俗话亦源自广东省各地。㜺鬼大使麦美恩遂将探索版图扩展至中国，并找来邓智坚、戴祖仪、许文轩加入「㜺鬼导赏团」，深入广州等内地城市，发掘相关的有趣典故及出处。专业粤语及典故专家亦会现身，追源溯古引经据典，揭示贴地粤语的魅力所在。此外，喜欢扮鬼扮马的邓智坚还于节目化身单身宅男，透过他追求一众「女神」的过程，让大家了解多个俗语及术语的含意。

programme.title: 2026英雄联盟全球总决赛冠亚军决赛直播粤普
programme.desc: 2026「英雄联盟」全球大赛在美国举行，韩国LCK战区第一种子GenG、中国LPL战区第二种子BLG，从瑞士轮、淘汰赛阶段杀出重围，会师总决赛战场。GenG中路明星选手Chovy与BLG中路左手战将Knight，迎来「左右手」巅峰对决，力争带领战队登上荣誉之巅。主持戴祖仪、林沚羿、彭家贤、电竞评述员老星、彭泳熙、嘉宾罗泳娴、小编吴文懿，坐镇TVB翡翠台，由开幕表演到BO5「中韩大战」全程直击！

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 热血军检
programme.desc: 【安普贤携手曹宝儿，成最强军检察官搭档！！】以韩国军事法庭为背景，为了各自目的而成为军检察官，都培万只想往上爬达成复仇目标，车友仁出身军法世家，为替父母讨回公道而回到军中。当军中黑暗势力浮上台面，他们选择不再服从命令，而是直面权力、揭露真相。在正义与复仇之间，两人逐步找回真正的信念，也点燃危险又炙热的同盟关系，从对立到并肩作战的故事。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破脸！命运抓弄下的同居奇迹】一场毁灭性的家庭变故，让原本关系紧绷的离婚婆婆、媳妇与小姑，命运交织地被迫同住在一个屋簷下。撕下以往的对立标签，三个性格迥异、伤痕累累的女人在满是摩擦与冲突的日常中，渐渐看清彼此的脆弱。她们相互扶持、携手抵御人生的逆境风浪，最终走出阴霾，共筑出比血缘更坚固的暖心情谊！

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 汉摩拉比小姐
programme.desc: 【高雅罗×金明洙×成东镒，三人三色法官个性，寻找法庭正义！！】三位个性截然不同的法官，在现实与理想间的挣扎与选择。热血直率的新任法官及冷静理性的资深法官同事。每一场审判，都是对人性与制度的考验。在案件背后，他们不只判案，更在学习如何面对自己心中的「正义」。

programme.title: 风起西州
programme.desc: 【《风起霓裳》最新续作！！许魏洲、古力娜扎续夫妻情缘，琴瑟和鸣的婚后生活及事业新考验！！】制衣才女库狄琉璃与裴行俭婚后面对大长公主的屡次使计刁难，琉璃聪慧应对，化险为夷。裴行俭因意外被贬远赴西州上任，夫妻携手同心，琉璃发挥自己的长才，传授西州百姓制衣技巧。裴行俭则守护西州百姓经济富足、安居乐业。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 时光之城
programme.desc: 【横跨两国人气演员的偶像剧，张哲瀚携手朴敏英初尝试爱情罗曼史！！】乐观积极的元气少女许真，在前往盖亚影视应征时撞见了当红炸子鸡顾持钧被前女友拒绝的场面。不希望丢脸的事情曝光的顾持钧则从中作梗想赶走许真，却阴错阳差的在盖亚集团二公子林晋修的帮助下，反而成为了顾持钧的助理。朝夕相处、情愫蔓延，却同时卷入了集团的阴谋，两人要如何逃出危机，让有情人终成眷属呢?

programme.title: 汉摩拉比小姐

programme.title: 红色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母抛家嫁富豪弃子重生只为揭穿母亲真面目】一段因爱与欲望而撕裂的亲情，点燃了跨越二十年的复仇烈火。年轻时的熙琼为追逐荣华，狠心抛夫弃子，投入旧情人赫相怀抱，却一步步被权力与野心吞噬。她的女儿珍玛在父亲离世、母亲弃养的阴影下成长，怀著深深怨恨潜入熙琼身边，以设计师与「继孙女」的身分逐步揭穿母亲的虚伪面具。母女之间爱恨交织，真相与谎言、亲情与仇恨轮番交锋，最终将迎来一场足以摧毁一切的命运对决。

programme.title: 等待京道
programme.desc: 【朴叙俊回归携手《鱿鱼2》元志安《等待京道》谱十年宿命恋】十年后的重逢，让李京道与徐智友再度陷入爱情的漩涡。曾是彼此初恋的两人，如今一个是追寻真相的记者，一个是丑闻风暴中的名门继承人。再见面时，他们早已不是年少时的模样，却依然在对方身上看见过去的自己。爱情与现实的距离，在一次次试探与退让间拉扯，他们明知前方满是荆棘，仍选择再次并肩。

programme.title: 灿烂的风和海
programme.desc: 【赛车手失意澳门 邂逅冷艳策展人共度浪漫情缘】在灯火辉煌的摄影棚与璀璨夺目的澳门之间，广告导演麦又歌为梦想与责任奔波，结识热心单纯的机车青年徐君乐，在彼此的陪伴下逐渐打开封闭的心门。同时，赛车手韩俊豪在失利阴影与媒体质疑中挣扎，却因邂逅神秘策展人陈嘉慧，而重新燃起追寻自我的勇气。四人在工作、梦想与爱情的交织里相遇，既面对现实的压力，也学会倾听心底的渴望。在陌生却绚烂的城市里，他们将一同经历命运的考验，找寻属于自己的方向。

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 女医明妃传
programme.desc: 【刘诗诗淡妆出镜美出新高度，妙手仁心成明朝一代女国医！！】女子地位低下的大明，不得从医也难治隐疾。杭允贤从小耳濡目染，偷偷随祖母学习中医知识，不仅在学医道路上面临重重的困难和阻碍，更要面对封建礼教和世俗观念的冲击。开创并建立女医制度，从救人身体到救人灵魂，悬壶济世、妙手仁心的名声，得到普通百姓的赞扬和支持。

programme.title: 装腔启示录
programme.desc: 初级律师唐影在上海红圈律所工作，意外结识了合作方许子诠。虽然二人暗生情愫，却始终没有勇气直面真实的情感。两人历经多次事件，最终在唐影的帮助下，许子诠驱散了多年阴影，敢于直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在许子诠的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真实的一面。

programme.title: 完全省钱恋爱手册
programme.desc: 【精打细算的恋爱，郭书瑶vs林子闳金钱价值观保卫战，有钱没钱都要爱！！】不追求恋爱的节俭会计师上班族简可可，平易近人做事俐落、个性率直又善良。碰上了花钱如流水的同事王海阔，是能力强、业界有名的王牌业务。对彼此逐渐动心的爱情，两人的金钱价值观却大大不同，要如何在爱情与面包做选择呢?

programme.title: 九尾狐传
programme.desc: 【人间九尾狐李栋旭苦等初恋大谈人狐千年禁忌恋！！】活在现代的九尾狐李砚，身兼著阎罗王姐姐的阴间使者指令，斩妖除魔苦苦等候初恋南智雅转世千年在今生相遇，做为半人半妖的同父异母弟弟李朗，频频与李砚作对搅局。过去亲情、爱情、友情的磨难及错误的种子，在此世会得到解答吗?

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Felix Finds His Voice
programme.desc: Messy the monster hears a chirping bird outside his window, but he can't understand what the bird is saying.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Pizzas Away
programme.desc: Mojo needs to deliver a pizza to a very hard-to-reach island, but some stubborn seabirds have their eye on the pizza. Will Mojo have to go supersonic to get past them?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Mum sets up a backyard obstacle course just for fun, but Dad wants to race! Now the kids are determined to win by any means necessary.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Bedroom
programme.desc: Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bed time comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Laughter Badge
programme.desc: From sensible chuckles and nervous giggles to Duggee's infectious laughter, once everyone starts, it's so hard to stop. What were they laughing about again? Anyone remember?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The In Charge Badge
programme.desc: What are the rules about being in charge? Make a plan, keep everyone happy, make decisions, lead by example and listen. Roly takes that one so seriously he gets a bit overwhelmed.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Stick Together
programme.desc: Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ping Pong Penguins
programme.desc: What’s that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? It’s the Penguins playing ping-pong!

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Sea Arch Escape
programme.desc: Xuli's flying race around the Academy inspires cadet Tala to fly the Grimbler. But she crashes into a fragile sea arch that could collapse right on top of her! The Go Jetters must race to save her.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Adventure
programme.desc: Princesses, horses and magic wands. Bluey and Chloe can play any role they want, when they embark on an adventure to save their playground kingdom from the Greedy Queen.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Dance Mode
programme.desc: After Dad eats her last chip, Bingo is given three chances to put Mum and Dad in "Dance Mode" as payback. But the others can't resist taking Bingo's turns for her.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. While recalling her favourite memories of playing with Bandit, Bluey struggles with the idea that her drawing must be perfect. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Explorers
programme.desc: While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Dino Treasure Hunt
programme.desc: When a pterosaur destroys Jen's dino proximity machine, Andy goes on an adventure to retrieve the pieces. Along the way, he meets velociraptors, an Alamosaurus and some hungry Gorgosaurus.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Hedgehog
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Sing Song Forest, where Tincy the Spider needs help from the Playtimers to wake up her furry friend, Hedge the Hedgehog.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Memory Badge
programme.desc: Happy discovers his wobbly tooth has come out, but he's lost it! He's having a problem remembering where he was when it fell out. The squirrels start to look for it but they can't find the tooth anywhere. Time to think carefully and remember!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Theatre Badge
programme.desc: Tino and Eugene are having a disagreement about an amateur dramatic show they want to put on. One wants an all singing all dancing extravaganza while the other, a serious drama. Can Duggee and the squirrels help them get something ready to perform?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Shadow Badge
programme.desc: The sun is setting, and the squirrels are sitting on the sofa. They've had a very busy day. Suddenly all the lights go out! POP! Oh dear, there's been a power cut. The squirrels can't see anything! Thanks, goodness Duggee has got his torch, and he has torches for everyone.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Nomads, Mongolia
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch is out on a camping expedition in Mongolia. There's not much around except a group of Mongolian nomads - people who travel around the country with their animals, camping in amazing tents called gers. Glitch visits their camp and inadvertently offends them, then his misfiring jetpack causes him to land on one of their precious horses, causing it to gallop away from the camp with Glitch on its back!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Gliding, Argentina
programme.desc: The Go Jet cadets are taking to the skies in Argentina in an attempt to pass their academy gliding test. As gliders do not have engines, Xuli is teaching two other pilot cadets how to glide using thermals to keep them up in the air. Not wanting to miss out on the aerial action, Grandmaster Glitch gatecrashes the flying lesson in his Grim Glider! Not only has his glider got an engine, but he also wants to make the lesson into a race. Not cool...

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - The Great Little Railway Show
programme.desc: A little railway show comes to Sodor and a misunderstanding leads to all the small engines on railway turning up at Ulfstead Castle to participate.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay S01 - Nikhil and Jay and the Missing Appalams﻿
programme.desc: Nikhil and Jay are detectives today. When the homemade appalams go missing under their watch, they need to solve the case and save lunch.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - First Aid
programme.desc: Myrtle calls Stanley to see if she can practice her first aid skills on him, but he's all fit and healthy. Instead, they go about the town making good use of Myrtle's newfound abilities.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Bug Hotel

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - Penguins Live in Igloos

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: It's news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he's got any news at all, remembers he's getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and that's what she's supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

But panic ensues when Glitch decides to broadcast his own, fake weather report - leaving the cadets and Grimbots stranded. Can the Go Jetters un-glitch their weather equipment and save the cadets?

But after a bend in the river, they encounter Glitch attempting to chop down one of the protected mangrove trees, hoping to impress Tala with the rare plant. Although they manage to stop him, the approaching dark and some thick mud leave them in a tricky situation. Can the team work out how to light their way and find their friends?

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Pirate Peril, Jamaica

But his efforts cause silt to churn up from the seabed, trapping Lars under the water. Will Xuli manage to get him free before his air runs out?

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Chang Cheh's epic “The Water Margin”, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Impoverished scholar Zhang Zhen seeks refuge with a chancellor's family, only to be scorned for his poverty. A carp spirit, moved by his plight, disguises herself as the chancellor's daughter and falls for him. Confusion over the two identical daughters draws a demon-hunting priest. Zhang Zhen refuses to abandon her, moving Guanyin to grant her mortal form.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daughter in hatred, training her into the fearsome "Silver Fox" and sending her out for revenge.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master “Shadow Whip”, he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to “Shadow Whip”?

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the ‘Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the ‘Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called “Five Poison Web”, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: After three years of wandering, legendary swordsman Li Xun Huan returns home, hoping for a peaceful life. Instead, countless fighters seek to kill him for fame. As chaos spreads, Li reunites with his estranged friend Ah Fei and joins forces with him to battle the deadly Money Clan, a rising threat determined to dominate the martial world.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fan's fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world...

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father...

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - “Twelve Deadly Coins” and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancee, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Zhong Mo Yuan - EP27
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Gifted salesman Siu Buck travels to Turkey to uncover his roots, only to find himself entangled in his spy father's dangerous legacy. Caught in an international conspiracy involving a lethal bioterror threat, he is thrust into a high-stakes chase. As danger closes in, Buck must push beyond his limits to stop a global crisis.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie becomes a night guard at an abandoned building. Hours after their shift change, the previous guard is found murdered in a locked room, making Wang the prime suspect. As eerie events unfold, three vengeful ghosts appear and reveal a revenge plot. With misfortune piling up, is it fate or a curse?

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: Scientist Yan Xin develops super rubber seeds and travels to a remote, lawless, drug-ridden region to cultivate them. Security captain Lin Xiang leads a team to protect his ex-wife and her crew, but they are besieged by a cartel on arrival. Lin Xiang and his men navigate hostile forces, vowing to take their enemies down with them.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs II
programme.desc: In this prequel, the secrets of “Infernal Affairs” are revealed - the resentment between police superintendent Wong and crime boss Sam, as well as the beginning of the parallel fates of the two moles, Yan and Ming. The keys lie in the hands of Sam's wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: Ten years ago, the ambitious Lord Conqueror sought a prophecy from the Mystic Soothsayer. Told that only two boys named “Wind” and “Cloud” could help him dominate the martial world, he took them as disciples. Though his ambition is fulfilled, the prophecy takes an unexpected turn, unleashing a catastrophe that changes the jianghu forever.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: After his father's death, the impoverished Kwan moves to the provincial capital and works at a textile workshop run by his late father's friend, retired martial artist Tuen. As a ruthless Manchu warlord exploits martial arts tournaments to expand his criminal influence, Kwan and his allies become entangled in a dangerous fight for justice.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Sent to Japan by his master, Chen Zhen rescues and falls in love with fellow student Hiroko Yamada, only to be drawn into the Black Dragon gang's conspiracy. As Chinese students disappear and Jing Wu Martial Arts School comes under attack, he joins Liang Shao Wen to destroy a secret lab, foil the conspiracy, and defend his nation's honour.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes
programme.desc: A series of murders at a munitions factory sparks fear of a “Phantom Bullet” that kills without a trace. Detective Song Dong Lu and sharpshooter Guo Zhui are tasked with solving the case. As they uncover layers of corruption and conspiracy, they are drawn into a deadly game where the truth is more dangerous than the bullets.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Furious Attack
programme.desc: Ex-special forces operative Lung infiltrates a lawless cross-border crime compound after his reporter daughter, On Sum, goes missing while investigating it. When he discovers she is caught in a larger conspiracy, an enraged Lung fights his way through the criminal forces, determined to expose the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Tea Party

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Tip Top Tapper
programme.desc: Olivia is disappointed when she hurts her leg on the eve of her big tap dance recital. But the show must go on! Taking inspiration from her baby brother William’s rolling walker, she builds herself a fanciful apparatus – the tip top tapper – so that she can dance as scheduled. Thanks to her new invention, her performance is a hit!

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Firefighter
programme.desc: A firefighter’s visit to Olivia’s classroom inspires Olivia and her friends to become make-believe firefighters themselves. Their first mission: to get Olivia’s cat Edwin into a tree, so they can rescue him. But their plan works a little too well: before long, every cat in the neighborhood is stuck in the tree!

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Best Gift Ever
programme.desc: Olivia’s baby brother William’s first birthday is coming up and Olivia is determined to find him the absolute best gift ever. But what does he want? After much sleuthing, she makes him a homemade xylophone… only to discover he likes the wrapping paper best of all.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S2 - Monster Movie Quacky Duck

Everyone is horrified, it’s FAR too cute! Whoever’s brought it to school must

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S2 - Dopplegangers Totally Bats!
programme.desc: Dopplegangers – The little monsters are excited because the headmasters have given them a special zapppy control device which can make them transform into anything. programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Tree Troubles Missing Pieces
programme.desc: When Marcus brings home the class tree sapling for the weekend, the Dew Drops see it starting to wilt and must cheer the sapling up, so Marcus can make sure to plant it for his class. When Athena accidentally breaks Lola's nature sculpture, the Dew Drops must go on a scavenger hunt to replace the missing pieces.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Ticket Trail Flying Solo
programme.desc: Lola, Dylan and Cassie have tickets to the carnival, but when Dylan loses his ticket, the Dew Drops set out to find it. When Phoebe accidentally gets tossed into Nicholas' diaper bag before a trip to the park, Phoebe has to help a baby bird, while Eden and Athena must help Marcus rehearse for his big concert.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Spinny Water Kelp's Song
programme.desc: Kelp and his underwater friends race around an obstacle course, but Cruz gets sucked into a whirlpool. As each of them try to rescue him, they are sucked in! Kelp saves them all using his unicorn spark to create bubbles he attaches to seaweed. Kelp helps his unicorn friends create music with their horns and pieces of nature. Ollie is embarrassed by the sound of his horn.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Playground Sparkless
programme.desc: Cruz decides to turn the sunken ship into a park. But all his and Kelp’s “fun-crastinating” puts the project in jeopardy. Kelp accidentally knocks a boulder into the stream, blocking the flow while trying his unicorn spark. Frustrated by magic, Kelp uses the narwhal way.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - King Burple

programme.desc: The dollhouse is immersed in imaginative Wild West play with Sheriff Gabby, Sheriff Pandy, and CatRat the Bandit. Sheriff Gabby and Sheriff Pandy must safely deliver gold to the bank, but it gets confiscated by Bandit CatRat! They go on an adventure to get the gold back and restore order in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - DJ Catnip Gets His Groove Back
programme.desc: Gabby brings DJ Catnip a microphone for him to use in the big music show, but he has some terrible news: he lost his groove! Determined to help him get his groove back, Gabby and Pandy take him on a musical search through the dollhouse. As they go, Gabby uses the microphone to record sounds from the Gabby Cats’ everyday activities that culminate into a new song that gets DJ his groove back just in time for the show! In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Gabby sings a song!

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - A Frog-let Tale
programme.desc: Lala, who's grown into a froglet, is ready to finally join the gang on a big adventure in the city! But she relies on her water bowl to get around, and Gloria goes overboard in trying to protect her tiny friend in the big world- only to realize that she underestimated all Lala is capable of doing.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Snow Day
programme.desc: When a snowstorm blocks Kate from accessing the zoo, Melman decides to become “substitute Kate” and make sure the animals are cared for. A series of stumbles makes Melman question whether he’s cut out to be a paramedic--until he learns that mastering a goal takes grit!

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - King of Camp Dancing Disco Zombies

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - The Time Disruptor
programme.desc: Archibald accidentally uses Loy’s time travel device, embarking on an adventure through past, present and future. programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S16 - Bizarro Bottom Squidward's Tough Break
programme.desc: SpongeBob falls asleep on the bus and ends up in a strange town full of Bikini Bottom doppelgangers. After Squidward loses his memory, he adopts a new tough guy persona.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S16 - Curse of the WereDoodle Gorilla Suit Day
programme.desc: DoodleBob bites SpongeBob, transforming him into a "WereDoodle". SpongeBob dresses up for Gorilla Suit Day and is mistaken for a real gorilla.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S16 - Exchange Student Driver The Kreepy Krab
programme.desc: Mrs. Puff sends SpongeBob far away to a driving school in Klopnod. Slappy brings his macabre sensibilities to the Krusty Krab when he's hired there as a server.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis S1 - Musical Mayhem Purrfect Punch
